Flein the Baldie

Overview

Flein the Baldie is a thief from the abandoned-mines district. He admits killing the investigator and planting a Woodsfolk arrow to shift the blame. Rather than steal from the Woodsfolk, he took an arrow from the governor’s collection, helped by a cloaked employer who knew how to bypass the magical traps. His testimony links the theft, murder and search for the Princess. [1, 2]

Karansul’s accounts and Baldie’s confession

Karansul first lets Baldie’s name slip while boasting that mechanical traps are better than magical ones, then denies knowing anything useful. Tilvar mentions the merchant’s mechanical grinder and the disruption caused when it breaks. Sver knows how to turn these leads into pressure. Zak first delivers the hunter’s furs to a buyer outside the merchant’s monopoly. Sver then reveals Karansul’s hidden trade and unpaid taxes, pointing to the foreman’s accounts; he also recommends Trickster as a teacher. With the accounts as leverage, Zak learns where to find Flein the Baldie, called Baldie, and secures a meeting. Evidence from the stolen collection makes the thief confess: he killed the Snoop, planted the Woodsfolk arrow and worked for a cloaked employer who knew how to evade the governor’s magical traps. [3, 4, 5, 1, 2, 6, 7, 8]
